Stalk $RELY (PEG Delayed Reaction)

Ascending triangle pattern remains intact within the PEG candle high as breakout level. Still have room to trade into apex of the triangle for further tighten prints

Stalk $DOCS (PEG Delayed Reaction)

On the wider perspective, it's still building a inverse head and shoulder pattern. Latest print is a lower low, still need to build a few more prints before Focus

Focus $ALM (Out of Weekly Downtrend Line)

+305% EPS +498% Sales YoY with muted action on release. Price is now +25% since, moved out of a 17-Week Downtrend Line. Only on its 3rd week out now with retracement action back between rising 10 and 20-MA with 2 sequential higher low

Focus $PBF (PEG Delayed Reaction)

Has attempt to break the high of the PEG print without conviction. But price has been resilient to any pullback. It is only 3 x ATR% from 50-MA trading right above the coiling of 10 and 20-MA. Seeking 20% RVOL within 30mins from open on ORH

Stalk $UNH via $UNHG 2x Long (PEG Delayed Reaction)

Has already build an ascending trend line, morphing into an ascending triangle after failure to break above $405-$406. Last 2 print comes with much higher volume, will require some VCP before Focus.

Stalk $LFST (Mini Bull Flag in Weekly)

Not in Focus as pre-market is already reflecting a potential gap down open. This can pullback and tighten more towards its rising 10 and 20-MA.

Stalk $OWL (Multi-Month Base)

Previously highlighted this on that 5 consecutive session of higher low prints in the 3rd week of August. Sept 1st did high RVOL breakdown but subsequent action held without follow through to the down side. Remains in my Stalk for near term VCP.

Stalk $SMR via $SMU 2x Long (Ascending Triangle Base Reversal)

This idea is below 100/150/200-MA but it's in my stalk because $SMU 2x is almost 14% ADR. I think it's the highest ADR idea anyone could have in the watchlist right now. Still stalking for further prints into Apex of

Focus $NEO (New Wedge on VCP)

6 days of tightened prints on low volume, inside rising 10 and 20-MA. This clearly needs very high RVOL if u base it on the last 2 recent times it did a breakout of a similar structure. Their move up are hardly sustainable without volumatic

Focus on last friday did not trigger but ended up with a tightened print and lowered volume. Remains a Focus today.
